title: Confessions: 4.29 Retry-After header + storage_full body need coap_oscore_send_protected payload/option support
description: Follow-up from eliz review (P3s): spec 18.10.3 requires 4.29 with Retry-After on rate-limit rejection and 18.9 storage_full 5.03 with a structured CBOR body, but coap_oscore_send_protected(resource, request, addr, addr_len, ctx, piv, piv_len, code) has no payload or option parameter — OSCORE-protected responses need the API extended (protect the body too) or an unprotected-detail policy decision. Both the confessions and deaddrop handlers need this once the API lands (oscore-bar: route to Mark/owner).
